# Version 4.156.0
> **Modern views and reliable lifetimes** · Released November 9, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.156.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 combines Skia m156 with GTK4 GPU rendering, Uno 7 support and font-lifetime fixes. Linux NoDependencies font discovery returns, Android continuous rendering follows display refresh, and native rendering fixes improve paths, clipping and text. Upgrading also requires attention to GTK4 coordinates, Uno controls, Apple and Tizen minimums, and malformed text buffers.

## Breaking Changes

- **Choose GTK4 logical or physical paint coordinates** — SKDrawingArea now defaults to physical-pixel CanvasSize and paint Info on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true to retain logical paint coordinates while keeping full-resolution backing pixels. RawInfo remains physical, and GTK input coordinates remain logical. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy for SKGLArea. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Move Uno integrations to Uno 7 and .NET 10** — The non-Windows Uno views require Uno 7 and .NET 10; old platform/runtime packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell integration are retired. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, drops RaiseOnUnsupported and uses a CPU fallback with null GRContext on non-Windows targets. Remove RaiseOnUnsupported usage and use SKCanvasElement when GPU rendering is needed. The Windows facade remains ANGLE-backed. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Raise Apple deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native libraries now require macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS or Mac Catalyst 15. Raise application deployment targets accordingly and retain any higher managed or framework minimum. These final floors supersede the earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Catalyst 14 baseline introduced during this release line. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Upgrade Tizen applications to Tizen 10** — The Tizen native packages now target net10.0-tizen10.0 and support x64 and arm64. Tizen 8/9 and former 32-bit build paths are no longer supported. Move applications and manifests to Tizen 10; custom native builds require the Tizen 10 SDK and GCC 14.2. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **Pass well-formed encoded text buffers** — Shared font text validation now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative byte lengths and ArgumentException for odd GlyphID byte counts before interop. Supply nonnegative lengths and complete 16-bit glyph IDs when counting, converting, measuring or building text paths. Encoded BreakText overloads return bytes; string and char-span overloads return UTF-16 code units. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))
- **Keep SKData copy lengths within the source array** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the source array. Pass an in-bounds length rather than relying on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Rebuild custom WebGPU archives** — Newer WebAssembly consumers require libSkiaSharp.a to include emdawnwebgpu's C++ support. Rebuild custom archives with Graphite enabled; pre-change and GPU-disabled archives do not satisfy this link contract. The port is no longer compiled on the application's final link line. Matching JavaScript glue remains a consumer link input, and this release line retains the .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Pass one encoded unit to GetUnicodeCharacterCode** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode now validates encoded byte width instead of UTF-16 string length. Pass ASCII for UTF-8, a BMP character for UTF-16 or one Unicode code point for UTF-32; use UTF-32 for supplementary characters. Previously accepted multi-character UTF-32 strings are rejected rather than silently returning the first character's code. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **Use supported Windows native targets** — The fork-specific WinRT native target is retired. Use the supported desktop Windows, WinUI/Windows App SDK or NanoServer paths rather than relying on that legacy target. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))

## Engine

- **Skia m156** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 156 without adding C bridge exports or changing core managed API signatures. HarfBuzzSharp's 14.4.0.100 package band still bundles HarfBuzz 14.4.0. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## API Surface

- **GTK4 GPU canvas** — SKGLArea adds GTK-owned GPU rendering with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, EnableRenderLoop and IgnorePixelScaling. Invalidate through GTK's QueueRender; automatic rendering defaults off. Raster drawing also corrects Cairo pixel-storage disposal and dirty notification. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux fonts and HarfBuzz coexistence** — Linux NoDependencies assets again discover fonts from /usr/share/fonts/ by default without requiring fontconfig. Bundled Linux HarfBuzz function calls stay within their own implementation, preventing incompatible system-library calls after GTK initializes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086), [#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Paths, clipping and text replay** — Corrects clipped convex-path rasterization, reflected zero-length hairline caps, text-atlas selection and serialized glyph replay validation. Graphite fixes cover inverse fills, stroke bounds, clip keys and alpha-to-RGBx readback; GLES no longer advertises an invalid BGRA upload combination. ([#5671](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5671), [#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631), [#5624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5624), [#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617), [#5575](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5575), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **Safer runtime shaders** — Rejects overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types earlier. Failed raster-pipeline construction no longer leaves executable partial branches, and transformed child failures propagate instead of running an incomplete pipeline. Region storage also accounts for subdivided conic edges to avoid undersized buffers. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517))
- **Character-code decoding** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode decodes one unit of the requested encoding: ASCII for UTF-8, a BMP character for UTF-16, or one Unicode code point for UTF-32. Use UTF-32 for supplementary characters. GetString now reports null byte arrays with ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **Display-paced Android rendering** — Automatic GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows Choreographer display callbacks instead of buffer-swap throughput. Explicit RequestRender calls remain independent, and drawing stays on the GL worker; this is not a guarantee of presentation timing. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Bounded font and view ownership** — DWriteCore custom-font data is released after the last typeface clone is disposed. Windows EGL teardown unbinds its own current context so removed SKGLView panels can be collected. Cached WGL pointers retain their OpenGL module, and native cleanup corrects optional stream callbacks and XPS COM ownership. ([#5577](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5577), [#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551), [#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))
- **Borrowed streams released on disposal** — Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. It does not dispose the borrowed stream: the caller remains responsible for that stream's lifetime. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Correct callback boolean widths** — Native callbacks now use one-byte Skia booleans and four-byte HarfBuzz hb_bool_t values while public managed delegates remain bool-based. This corrects the callback ABI, including Apple ARM64 interpreter returns and false-returning HarfBuzz callbacks. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Fewer conversion allocations** — Valid managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation. HarfBuzzSharp pools AddUtf32 string encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocation while preserving decoding and invalid-input behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Runtime-matched WebAssembly assets** — .NET 11+ selects Emscripten 6.0.2 archives, while .NET 9/10 retains 3.1.56 and .NET 8 retains 3.1.34 in this line. Newer WebGPU assets include the C++ port in libSkiaSharp.a, avoiding C++ flags on application C sources; matching JavaScript glue remains a link input. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306), [#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Updated Windows integration** — Refreshes WinUI's ANGLE engine to chromium/8118 and aligns library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 without changing the declared Windows runtime minimum. AnyCPU native asset selection uses portable win-x86, win-x64 and win-arm64 RIDs instead of legacy win10-* identifiers. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 in the 14.4.0.100 package band. It reduces UTF-32 and feature-string allocations, corrects callback boolean widths, selects runtime-matched WebAssembly assets and adopts the new Apple and Tizen deployment floors.

## Release Candidate 1 (November 4, 2026)

Adds Uno 7 support, display-paced Android rendering, font and stream lifetime fixes, and corrected callback ABI widths. Apple native minimums become macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS or Mac Catalyst 15, alongside stricter text-buffer validation.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10...v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11)

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)

Introduces Skia m156, GTK4 GPU drawing and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. GTK4 painting defaults to physical pixels, WebAssembly assets align with .NET 11, and Tizen packages require Tizen 10.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.155.1...v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)
